svg.title: J4 WhatsApp reminder from a customer row, with the pay page (since v1.2.1)

g.text: J4 WhatsApp reminder from a customer row, with the pay page (since v1.2.1)
Built at every render, before any tap
which a browser never sends to a server
until set, the demo ID hisaab.demo@upi
since v1.5.2.1 (sendways.js): while no UPI ID is set,
a notice beside the reminder controls says the reminder
carries the demo ID, with a link to Shop settings
[Settings: owner saves shop name and UPI ID]
nothing is saved; empty is allowed
a plain link; no click handler in app.js
the app never sends by itself
[customer taps the https "UPI pay link" (WhatsApp makes it tappable)]
[customer taps the upi:// link, where the phone makes it tappable]
[on the customer page: UPI pay link (#cust-upi), shown when bal above zero]
